name: Disappearances
content:
MORE PEOPLE MISSING FROM LOCAL AREA - JUNE 1992. 

Reports continue to come in from the local area that more people have gone missing. Always at night and seemingly at random. Is this the work of a criminal, potentially a killer?|We put the question to chief Orange: 

'The very idea that local area could be the unwitting playground of a monster is pure science fiction. We are currently investigating several leads, all of which have given us no reason to suggest foul play. It is important to understand that these disappearances are relatively recent and no bodies have been found.' 

The investigation continues.
